title: 10.0.0 | Jason Patch Notes
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/44c17b02feb78fb8f5a9f6bdaeac946630aa9e3a.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]NEW KILLER: THE SLASHER[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]POWER: OMNIPRESENT EVIL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Press the Active Ability button to activate Omnipresent Evil. The Slasher becomes invisible and gains Undetectable, but cannot see Survivors or their Scratch Marks. Mist Clouds reveal the location of Survivors who are not moving. Footprints reveal the path of Survivors who are walking or running.[/p][/*][*][p]Omnipresent Evil is deactivated by using Jump Scare.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]SPECIAL ABILITY: JUMP SCARE[/b][/h3][list][*][p]While Omnipresent Evil is activated, look at a Pallet, Breakable Wall, or Window to quickly move to it and perform a special-break or special-vault action. The Secondary Action button switches the side you will face when performing Jump Scare.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump Scare exits Omnipresent Evil mode, grants Haste, and reveals detected Survivors with Killer Instinct.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]SPECIAL ABILITY: THROWING SPIKES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Grab a Spike from Scrap Piles or Hooks. Hold the Secondary Action button to ready the Spike and tap the Attack button to throw. Spikes are replenished throughout the map when Omnipresent Evil is activated.[/p][/*][*][p]A Spike knocks back a Survivor and damages them for one health state.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors will be Impaled if they are hit with a Hook Spike. They cannot heal past the injured state and the embedded Hook Spike will have an Aura visible to the Killer.[/p][/*][*][p]Injured Survivors will be both Impaled and Immobilized if they are hit with a Spike and knocked into a wall.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Killer Perks[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Hex: Scared to Death[/b][/p][list][*][p]After you hook [b]3[/b] different Survivors, a Dull Totem ignites.[/p][/*][*][p]While chasing a Survivor, whenever you basic-break a Pallet, Survivors within [b]13[/b]m:[/p][list][*][p]Scream.[/p][/*][*][p]Gain [b]11/12/13%[/b] [b]Hindered [/b]for [b]3[/b]s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Silent Shadow[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you hook a Survivor, you gain [b]Undetectable [/b]for [b]11/12/13s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When all Generators are completed, you gain [b]Undetectable[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Rampage[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, you earn [b]1[/b] Token, up to [b]13[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, for the next [b]13s[/b] you gain [b]1%[/b] [b]Haste [/b]for each Token. Cooldown: [b]30/25/20[/b]s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]Auras Customization[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New aura types are available for color customization[/p][list][*][p]Blocked Objects (e.g. [i]Corrupt Intervention [/i]or [i]Repressed Alliance[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Completed Generators (e.g as The Houndmaster sending The Dog on a Search Command)[/p][/*][*][p]Generator Progress (The starting color when a Generator's progress is revealed e.g. [i]Hex: Hive Mind [/i]or the add-on [i]"All Seeing" - Spirit[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Dull Totems (When a player doesn't know the state of a Totem it will show as a Dull Totem e.g. [i]Detectives Hunch[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Cleansed Totems (e.g. [i]Hex: Pentimento)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Hex Totems[/p][/*][*][p]Boon Totems[/p][/*][*][p]Hatch[/p][/*][*][p]Exit Gate Switches[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Killer Power Match Details Tab[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Match Details have been updated with a new tab to provide a simplified description of the currently faced Killer's power[/p][/*][*][p]Match Details will only show this information when one of the following occurs:[/p][list][*][p]Any Survivor enters a chase[/p][/*][*][p]Any Survivor loses a health state[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Killer Power Tab can be directly accessed by pressing[b] F1 [/b]on Keyboard or pressing and holding [b]SELECT [/b]on Controller[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Visual Change[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Doctor[/p][list][*][p]Remove the Doctor's noise vignette when using his power or when a survivor get shocked[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the intensity of the light when the Doctor used his power[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the intensity of the camera shake when a survivor get shocked[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Sable Ward's ''Sassy Guest'' outfit is missing the lobby music.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivor hit audio does not play at a long distance for the Killer when the Survivor is hit by a projectile at long Mori.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors do not produce grunts when they are dropped by The Animatronic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Missing sound effects when interacting with Memory Shards and Archives Portal.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Trickster's mori preview VO is difficult to hear due to being at a too low volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where as a Survivor, the audio cue for The Nightmare's Dream Projection does not play when teleporting to a generator[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hook voice over could play during sacrifice if the Survivor is the last one standing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Jake Park being in a lobby could trigger other lobby dialogs when a second player also joins as Jake Park.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph can see shadows through walls after exiting a Tunnel in Greenville Square.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an Button add-on description was missing the fact it grants blind immunity for The Legion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Female Survivor's facial animations were missing when caught in a locker by the Singularity.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Knight's camera remained immobile when interrupting a Survivor who is either entering or exiting a Locker.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Knight did not have a Highlight Aura for guard orders on Pallets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Knight's Killer Power and the basic attack were accessible immediately after cancelling the Killer Power.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The First's Vines Attack hitting a Survivor while they were Dropping a Pallet caused them to be unable to enter the Floating State.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the headset was misaligned with the hand and head of the Survivor when interacting with a Grandfather Clock.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Legion's Feral Frenzy stopped recharging during the Mori.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors received no Exposed SFX after removing Crows from The Artist's Garden of Rot add-on.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Warg's Fang" add-on for The Dark Lord only showed the aura of the last Survivor's Scent Orb.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, sometimes, The Houndmaster's Dog was unable to Jump Pallets at sharp angles.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Demogorgon's Active Portals auras were always revealed for the Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Mastermind was unable to freely move the Camera direction between Dash Buffering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Mastermind could hit a Survivor at a lower altitude after vaulting with Virulent Bound.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Mastermind's supply case auras were hidden to Survivors suffering from Blindness.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Mastermind Virulent Bound Dash buffering "resetting hand" Animation was played too early.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors were frequently missing the thrown and the colliding against obstacle animations from The Mastermind's Virulent Bound.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Doctor was able to see the auras of Illusionary Doctors at Madness Tier without add-ons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors were missing their Reverse Bear Trap when The Pig used the Video Tape Add-On.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a Survivor was counted as 'Escaped' despite dying with the Reverse Bear Trap on while playing against The Pig.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the legs animation was missing after a Slice & Dice attack, and after missing a Basic Attack as The Good Guy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera, Look-At, and carry FPV animations for The Good Guy were broken cosmetic.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue by adjusting a collision In the astrology room in The Forgotten Ruins, a vault point has extended collision, [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Lich's Hand of Vecna failed to teleport a Survivor when used on a specific locker in Raccoon City Police Station West Side.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Lich's Hand of Vecna failed to teleport a Survivor when used on a specific locker in the Treatment Theatre.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hex: No One Escapes Death was revealed to Survivors immediately when generators were completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, rarely, the Aura of Fake Pallets could be seen by The Xenomorph throughout the map while using Ultimate Weapon and a Survivor had Apocalyptic Ingenuity.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hex: The Third Seal activated when The Trickster hit a Survivor with a blade for the first time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Heal progress bar remained grey while healing another Survivor with Do No Harm activated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Streetwise's aura reading activated with 3 Killer Items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where THWACK! was unable to be activated on Breakable Walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the external perk icon for Thanatophobia was displayed when performing actions with no injured, downed or hooked Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where AFK crows could appear on Survivor's heads while working on a generator after using the perk Plot Twist and being picked up by the Killer.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Platforms[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where an Asynchronous Load between the Survivor and the Killer caused the Killer to load partially invisible and Uncontrollable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Player shadows could be seen at the bottom of lockers on Switch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could not accept or view each other's profile in the friend list on the Epic Game Store version.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it was unable to make progress on the "Resourceful" achievement/trophy.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Quests[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where selecting Knockout (Remix) Challenge from the Tomes whilst having a Survivor Challenge make perk randomization impossible.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Quests Menu where the Match queue text for Killers overlapped some Quest buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a localization issue with the scroll prompt in the quest menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Keybind icon buttons were missing on the HUD when channeling interactions.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Misc[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where, rarely, the loading screen temporarily freezes on 'Initializing Shaders' screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed entity potentially making an invalid purchase move on the Bloodweb.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain map specific achievements failing to complete in 2v8.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Survivor having the Killer Name after using 'Play While You Wait'.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where using 'Play While You Wait' and leaving a Survivor Lobby the priority queue for the Killer Lobby was also lost.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Flicker VFX was missing when a Survivor used a Flashlight with the Broken Bulb Add-on.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Changes from PTB 
[/b][/h2][h2][b]New Killer: The Slasher[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]NEW KILLER POWER:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Pinned rescues are no longer considered healing actions[/p][/*][*][p]The Killer husk attack now activates with a slight delay and is no longer instant upon appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the slowdown effectiveness of the anti-camp system from x2 to x3 time in sec.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the movement speed penalty when cancelling the charge Projectile action.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW KILLER ADDONS:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Toxic Waste:[/p][list][*][p]Activation range increased to 8m (was 6m)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Coroner's Coffee:[/p][list][*][p]Haste decreased to 8% (was 13%)  [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bloody Magazine:[/p][list][*][p]Detection range decreased to 8m (was 13m)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Eye Goop:[/p][list][*][p]Undetectable duration increased to 13s (was 9s)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Iridescent Boat Motor:[/p][list][*][p]Window block duration increased to 13s (was 5s)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Deputy's Badge:[/p][list][*][p]Reworked: While in Omnipresent Evil, passing within 4m of a generator will cause it to explode, losing 5% progress and begin regressing. If any Survivors are repairing the generator, it will not explode, but they get a special Skill Check.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW PERKS:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Silent Shadow:[/p][list][*][p]Changed the perk so that the [b]11/12/13s[/b] Undetectable occurs whenever you hook a Survivor, instead of at the start of the trial.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Killer Power Match Details Tab[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated the default icon of Special Attack, Ranged Attack, and Special Ability to no longer reuse existing power icons[/p][/*][*][p]Updated all descriptions to utilize more consistent language[/p][/*][*][p]Updated several descriptions to provide more clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the description of The Wraith, The Knight, and The Skull Merchant to be more accurate and in depth[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bot Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with AI characters being unable to navigate
